notes: crush scans ~/.claude/skills natively, so claude skills need no port. compatibility=native means the stock skill directory is picked up as-is.
claude/commands/*.md are Claude Code command-runtime files; crush has no equivalent runtime, so those stay claude-only unless a crush agent profile is authored later.

classifications.reason: crush discovers ~/.claude/skills and project .claude/skills without configuration; our 33 skills use only name+description frontmatter, which the Agent Skills standard parses
Claude command runtime (slash-command files); crush invokes skills via its command palette, not claude command files
Claude sub-agent roster; crush has no sub-agent registry equivalent (kimi CLI has agent profiles if a port is ever needed)
Guard/approval hooks are settings.json PreToolUse-based; crush hooks are preliminary and need a dedicated port with its own review
crush reads ~/.config/AGENTS.md and project AGENTS.md; a symlink or generated copy covers it, but that materialization is a setup step, not automatic
